roles: discover minimum MTU along an IPv4 path

operations.monitoring: Hosts maintain/adjust a path MTU estimate based on feedback.
operations.diagnostics: Black-hole behavior can occur when required ICMP feedback is filtered.
operations.failure_behavior: Packets too large for a hop with DF set are dropped and should elicit fragmentation-needed ICMP feedback.
operations.operator_interface: Kernel/network stack PMTU state and packet diagnostics.

open_questions: Trace classic PMTUD implementation into BSD and Linux.

related_artifacts.notes: Relies on ICMP Destination Unreachable fragmentation-needed signaling.

notes: Later operational algorithm grown from original IPv4 fragmentation controls and ICMP error reporting.
